# Miauterm 0.1.3-coral

Small fixes for launcher shortcuts and terminal modifiers.

- Fix the three app-icon long-press shortcuts so Android opens Miauterm's installed activity.
- Make the extra-key `SHIFT` toggle work like `CTRL` and `ALT` for the next terminal input.

This release keeps the Coral codename and includes signed ARM64 APKs with SHA-256 checksums. Install on Android 7.0 or newer with an ARM64 processor.
